component.name: TagMender
component.summary: Identify, tag and organise music with MusicBrainz and Discogs

description.p: TagMender identifies albums and single tracks with MusicBrainz and Discogs as equal sources, previews every change, writes tags the way MusicBrainz Picard does without needing Picard, and organises files with journaled operations that can be undone.
